- "false_data": financial figures that are implausible or contradict the rest of the text; restatements with no filing reference; edited statements; invented guidance; a page that says other sources are superseded.

- "spoof": market data that is implausible for the instrument (prices far from the surrounding quotes, fake corporate actions such as splits with no record, coordinated identical headlines, look-alike domains, fake wires).
